When was your last dental check-up?

Regular dental check-ups help catch small problems before they become bigger ones. Our dentists see adults and children.

Always feeling tired? Check your Vitamin D
هل تشعر بالتعب دائماً؟

Low vitamin D is common in the UAE, even with all the sunshine. A simple blood test shows your level, and our doctor can advise you on the result.

Have you had your flu vaccine this year?
ഫ്ലൂ വാക്സിൻ എടുത്തോ?

The flu vaccine is recommended every year, and it matters most for older adults, young children, pregnant women and people with long-term conditions. Ask our team if it's right for you.
